name: Fonyód (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the town arms of Fonyód (a blue shield with a ship, with a helm, a yellow griffin crest and red and blue mantling) above the name FONYÓD in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Fonyód arms with helm, crest and mantling
